verdict.rationale: Requesty is documented as an OpenAI-compatible unified gateway. A developer swaps the base_url to router.requesty.ai/v1 and reaches 300–600+ models across providers with no SDK changes. The docs also say behavior stays consistent across providers: structured outputs work the same regardless of provider, and one web-search tool definition is translated to each provider's format. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-provider consistency (all evidence is vendor docs), and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
